rcxd_ode_user_class_rootcause_20260915.status: root cause proven from the crash dump and the retained assembly; fix direction corrected; NOT yet implemented
rcxd_ode_user_class_rootcause_20260915.finding: dxUserGeom::computeAABB indexes user_classes by the RAW class id, while ODE_CreateGeom indexes it by id-11. The two disagree by exactly the dFirstUserClass base, so the dispatch reads past the populated region and calls a zeroed function pointer.
evidence: Dump CrashDumps/sh1x_dedrun_next.exe.106544.dmp, PE TimeDate 6AA9ED99 / SizeOfImage 0x12263000 = build 2035702B, matching bin/codol_ks_audit.exe. ACCESS_VIOLATION 0xC0000005, 'execute of 0x0', eip=0.
Stack resolved against that build: RunGroundVehicleFrame+0x25E -> StepVehiclePulseWorld+0xD03 -> dxSimpleSpace::collide -> dxSimpleSpace::cleanGeoms -> dxUserGeom::computeAABB+0x20.
Disassembly of dxUserGeom::computeAABB (0x59F325): mov 0x4(%eax),%edx (geom->type, RAW); lea (%edx,%edx,4),%edx (type*5); call *0x12569f90(,%edx,4) - user_classes[type], stride 20, NO subtraction.

ODE_CreateGeom (_collision_kernel.asm ~560-578): lea eax,[edi+edi*4-0x37]; lea esi,[eax*4] - that is (classid-11)*20, the CORRECT index - and then mov [ebx+0x4],edi stores geom->type as the RAW classid.
dCreateGeomClass (_collision_kernel.asm 1064-1085) stores the class at index num_user_classes and RETURNS num_user_classes+0xb, confirming the id base of 11.

Register state at the fault: edx=0x3C=type*5, so geom->type=12, i.e. the second registered class. Only about five classes are registered (five dCreateGeomClass calls in Phys_InitBrushGeomClass), so index 12 is past the populated region and its aabb slot is zero.

The sibling dxUserGeom::AABBTest (0x59F347) uses the same raw indexing but NULL-checks the pointer before calling, which is why this has never been noticed: it silently does nothing instead of crashing.
rcxd_ode_user_class_rootcause_20260915.why_it_never_fired_before: The retained engine avoids this path: it has ODE_CollideSimpleSpaceWithGeomNoAABBTest (_collision_space.asm:122) and uses Phys_NearCallback, so its brush/cylinder user-class geoms are never AABB-cleaned. Codex's owned vehicle world is the first code to put user-class geoms into a plain dSpaceCollide (vehicle_ode.cpp:348 and vehicle_pulse_world.inc:257), whose dxSimpleSpace::collide calls cleanGeoms -> computeAABB on every geom.
rcxd_ode_user_class_rootcause_20260915.fix_direction_correction: The proposed fix of populating user_classes for the owned space would NOT work and should not be attempted: the table is populated correctly already, at index id-11; it is the CONSUMER that is wrong, and it is wrong for every user class, not just class 12. The correct fixes are (1) correct dxUserGeom::computeAABB - and AABBTest - in _collision_kernel.asm to index user_classes by id-11, matching ODE_CreateGeom's own convention, which makes the retained ODE self-consistent and is a one-instruction change per site; or (2) give the owned vehicle world the same no-AABB collide entry the retained engine uses. (1) is preferred under the vanilla mandate and has a small blast radius because the only code reaching it today is already broken.

match_report_na_bot_latch_20260915.cause: NA_BOT is 0 and so is NA_BAD (src/sys_net.h:53-54), so an un-set-up netchan reads as a bot. SV_DirectConnect attaches the secure profile at src/sv_client.c:505 and only calls Netchan_Setup at :569, so match_report latched client_is_bot() 64 lines before the netchan existed and recorded every human as a bot. humans stayed 0, the write was declined, and the bot-gated detail lines printed nothing.
match_report_na_bot_latch_20260915.corollary: The row existed at all, and a frozen row is only kept when a counter is non-zero, so the kill DID reach sess. The engine counters were never the problem.
match_report_na_bot_latch_20260915.fix: A row exists only because a secure profile attached and AutoBindClientSecureProfile refuses a zero uid, so every stored row is a human by construction: the latch is removed, client_is_bot() carries the NA_BOT/NA_BAD trap in a comment and is consulted only where the netchan is real, bot rows are synthesised at write time from connected slots owning no row, and MatchReportHumansConnected() counts a slot as human when it owns a row or is not NA_BOT.
match_report_na_bot_latch_20260915.also: tableLookup miss on mp/statstable.csv column 4 is BENIGN - _utility.gsc:2152 getWeaponClass() probes by name and expects the miss for non-weapons, falling through to isKillstreakWeapon(); it is a Com_DPrintf diagnostic, not an error. Kills were invisible because the vendor obituary goes to games_mp.log via G_LogPrintf; _damage.gsc Callback_PlayerKilled now prints a 'kill:' line for any death a human took part in. Assists added to the activity sum; time played deliberately excluded so a duration-only report cannot replace an unconsumed one.
